audit.method: unique contiguous P2 interrupt-ID window with timestamp/order tolerance 150 ms; 120 ms default does not accept all entries

interpretation: The exact 120 ms join rejects the complete callback sequence because one row is 150 ms late. At 150 ms the helper finds a unique continuous timestamp/order window, with 748/749 rows within 120 ms. This is a near-candidate only; it is not callback causality, payload equivalence, or proof of the reason the original guest queue predicate stayed pending.
